title: The Flash #39
desc:
THE JUSTICE LEAGUE VS. THE FLASH?!

The Justice League wants the Flash to stop fighting crimes that haven't happened yet. The Flash wants to keep doing that because he's saving people. You can see how they're at an impasse.

But when the league tries to shut this new crime-fighting tactic down, Wally doesn't take kindly to the intrusion. It's the League versus the Flash—and Wally needs your help to win!

Plus, a new villain is revealed.
